nodes.rationale: The candidature and the living dossier are the same rows so history cannot drift; missing is derived, never stored.

nodes.label: Legacy tables renamed aside to *_legacy, not dropped
nodes.norm_label: legacy tables renamed aside to *_legacy, not dropped
nodes.rationale: Unused spec_domain tables collided by name with new ones; renamed rather than dropped until production is confirmed empty; chef_documents.chef_profile_id NOT NULL fails on purpose rather than silently deleting an identity document.

nodes.label: Add Brevo template workflow
nodes.rationale: Create templates/BREVO_TPL_<NAME>.html, register env var in env.validation.ts, config.loader.ts (brevo.templates) and .env.example, add a mailer method, run node --test, PR, then upload.mjs creates it and the id is set on Railway and .env.

nodes.label: Contact forms: stored first, emailed second
nodes.norm_label: contact forms: stored first, emailed second
nodes.rationale: An email outage never loses a message; rate-limited per IP and per email with a honeypot; a reply is emailed before it is recorded so a failed send stores nothing (503 EMAIL_NOT_SENT).

nodes.label: Batch cookers in the back office (LF-0164, GET /admin/chefs)
nodes.norm_label: batch cookers in the back office (lf-0164, get /admin/chefs)
nodes.rationale: Built on chef_profiles, not candidatures, so pre-FLOW-01 profiles are listed; STATE_WHERE is the single definition of online/offline/suspended/pending for filter, counts and rows; deleted accounts never listed.

nodes.label: Brevo template security rules
nodes.rationale: Only params declared on the params: line, no contact.*, no unescaped output (|safe, autoescape off, raw), href/src only https:/mailto:/server-built *Url params, only *Url params inside HTML attributes because names/cities/dish titles/admin reasons are typed by people (some on a public form).

nodes.label: params: line contract
nodes.rationale: Each template header declares its params; the backend mailer method must send exactly those params, and tests check templates use nothing else.

nodes.label: Brevo shared email layout
nodes.rationale: Shared shell (Lab's Food header, footer with contact@labsfood.fr, <!-- title --> and <!-- content --> slots); light color scheme only, MSO conditional table for Outlook.

nodes.label: Application approved email (BREVO_TPL_APPLICATION_APPROVED)
nodes.rationale: params: firstName dashboardUrl. Welcomes a verified batch cooker.

nodes.label: Application received email (BREVO_TPL_APPLICATION_RECEIVED)
nodes.rationale: params: firstName reference signInUrl expiresAt. Carries the only way into the new account (one-time sign-in link); never remove signInUrl.

nodes.label: Application received admin email (BREVO_TPL_APPLICATION_RECEIVED_ADMIN)
nodes.rationale: params: reference applicationId name city adminUrl. Sent to admin inbox, also on reapply; name and city come from the public form.

nodes.label: Application rejected email (BREVO_TPL_APPLICATION_REJECTED)
nodes.rationale: params: firstName reason allowReapplyAfter. allowReapplyAfter null means reapply at once; account stays; documents deleted 3 months after decision.

nodes.label: Changes requested email (BREVO_TPL_CHANGES_REQUESTED)
nodes.rationale: params: firstName message documentLabels dossierUrl. Admin-written message shown as written; documentLabels never empty.

nodes.label: Chef suspended email (BREVO_TPL_CHEF_SUSPENDED)
nodes.rationale: params: firstName documentLabel dossierUrl. Only time the platform takes a storefront offline without a human decision (mandatory document expired); lifted on upload of an updated version.

nodes.label: Contact received admin email (BREVO_TPL_CONTACT_RECEIVED_ADMIN)
nodes.rationale: params: name email phone subject message site inboxUrl. Internal heads-up when a public contact form is sent; Reply-To is the visitor.

nodes.label: Contact reply email (BREVO_TPL_CONTACT_REPLY)
nodes.rationale: params: firstName subject reply originalMessage. Admin's answer from the console, sent as written, quoting the visitor's message; Reply-To is the team.

nodes.label: Content suspended email (BREVO_TPL_CONTENT_SUSPENDED)
nodes.rationale: params: kind title reason reasonCode menus recipesUrl. Dish or menu takedown; copyright/inappropriate-content takedowns also delete the dish photo.

nodes.label: Document expiring email (BREVO_TPL_DOCUMENT_EXPIRING)
nodes.rationale: params: firstName documentLabel expiresOn daysLeft dossierUrl. daysLeft is the notice threshold crossed (60, 30 or 7), hence 'd'ici'.

nodes.label: Document rejected email (BREVO_TPL_DOCUMENT_REJECTED)
nodes.rationale: params: firstName documentLabel reason dossierUrl. Admin-written reason shown as written.

nodes.label: New message email (BREVO_TPL_NEW_MESSAGE)
nodes.rationale: params: firstName senderName unreadCount conversationUrl. Sent by the messaging job after 10 min unread, once per burst; never quotes the message, which would bypass masking of contact details.

nodes.label: Sign-in link email (BREVO_TPL_SIGN_IN_LINK)
nodes.rationale: params: firstName signInUrl expiresAt. Sent when an admin re-sends a sign-in link; never remove signInUrl.

nodes.label: Source recipe changed email (BREVO_TPL_SOURCE_CHANGED)
nodes.rationale: params: dishName recipesUrl. Lab's Food source proposal changed on a sensitive point (allergens, diets, recipe country); the chef's dish is untouched.

nodes.label: signInUrl invariant
nodes.rationale: APPLICATION_RECEIVED and SIGN_IN_LINK must keep href=params.signInUrl: it is the candidate's only way into their account.

nodes.label: Upload digest drift detection
nodes.rationale: Every upload stamps an 'uploaded <digest>' comment before </body>; --check uses it to tell a repo change from a Brevo editor edit, and --update refuses to overwrite a Brevo edit without --force.

nodes.rationale: With URSSAF avance immediate the client gets a 50% tax credit on the amount paid, so booking yourself is a tax-credit fraud surface; must ship with the switcher, and closes a hole that already exists since booking creation never checks client != chef.

nodes.label: In-house messaging (chef_client and support conversations)
nodes.rationale: Stream was dropped; one conversation per (client, chef profile) pair; one writer (MessagingService.postMessage); a conversation the caller is not part of is 404; writable while a booking is pending or confirmed and 14 days after completion.

nodes.norm_label: redis optional (in-process fallback for messaging rate limit and events)
nodes.rationale: With REDIS_URL the 20/minute send limit and events are shared between instances; without it both are in-process, fine for one instance and wrong for two.

nodes.label: Automatic-suspension episode (chef_profiles.auto_suspended_at)
nodes.rationale: auto_suspended_at IS NOT NULL AND is_active means live on an unreviewed document; those dossiers sort first in the admin queue; validating clears it, refusing takes the chef offline; an admin-deactivated chef is never auto-reactivated.

nodes.rationale: *.railway.internal is reachable only service-to-service inside Railway; browsers, Swagger and frontends must use the public domain https://lf-api.labsfood.fr.

nodes.label: Contact details masked when served, not when stored
nodes.norm_label: contact details masked when served, not when stored
nodes.rationale: messages.body is always what was written; a detected phone or email is served masked and the conversation flagged for admins, who read the original; regex detection is deterrence, not a guarantee.

nodes.norm_label: env precedence: repo-root .env.local overrides shell exports
